datasets.name: 0c4b3134
queryLines:
SELECT *, ROUND(this_period_raw, 1) AS this_period, ROUND(last_year_raw, 1) AS same_days_last_year,
       ROUND(change_raw, 1) AS change_vs_ly
FROM (
SELECT CAST(revenue_mtd AS DOUBLE) AS revenue_mtd,
       CAST(ROUND((revenue_mtd / NULLIF(revenue_ly, 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS revenue_change_pct,
       CAST(ROUND(margin_pct_mtd, 1) AS DOUBLE) AS margin_pct_mtd,
       stack(6,
         1, 'Net revenue (LKR m)', CAST(revenue_mtd / 1e6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(revenue_ly / 1e6 AS DOUBLE),
            CAST((revenue_mtd / NULLIF(revenue_ly, 0) - 1) * 100 AS DOUBLE),
         2, 'Gross margin %', CAST(margin_pct_mtd AS DOUBLE), CAST(margin_pct_ly AS DOUBLE),
            CAST(margin_pct_mtd - margin_pct_ly AS DOUBLE),
         3, 'Paid invoices', CAST(invoices_mtd AS DOUBLE), CAST(invoices_ly AS DOUBLE),
            CAST((invoices_mtd / NULLIF(invoices_ly, 0) - 1) * 100 AS DOUBLE),
         4, 'Active customers', CAST(customers_mtd AS DOUBLE), CAST(customers_ly AS DOUBLE),
            CAST((customers_mtd / NULLIF(customers_ly, 0) - 1) * 100 AS DOUBLE),
         5, 'Average invoice value (LKR 000)', CAST(aiv_mtd / 1e3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(aiv_ly / 1e3 AS DOUBLE),
            CAST((aiv_mtd / NULLIF(aiv_ly, 0) - 1) * 100 AS DOUBLE),
         6, 'Returns rate %', CAST(returns_pct_mtd AS DOUBLE), CAST(returns_pct_ly AS DOUBLE),
            CAST(returns_pct_mtd - returns_pct_ly AS DOUBLE)
       ) AS (row_order, kpi, this_period_raw, last_year_raw, change_raw)
FROM (
  SELECT
    MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS revenue_mtd,
    MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS revenue_ly,
    MAX(gross_margin_pct) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS margin_pct_mtd,
    MAX(gross_margin_pct) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS margin_pct_ly,
    MAX(invoice_count) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS invoices_mtd,
    MAX(invoice_count) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS invoices_ly,
    MAX(active_customers) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS customers_mtd,
    MAX(active_customers) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS customers_ly,
    MAX(average_invoice_value) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS aiv_mtd,
    MAX(average_invoice_value) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS aiv_ly,
    MAX(returns_rate_pct) FILTER (WHERE is_month_to_date) AS returns_pct_mtd,
    MAX(returns_rate_pct) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_month_to_date) AS returns_pct_ly
  FROM (
    SELECT `is_month_to_date`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`, MEASURE(`gross_margin_pct`) AS `gross_margin_pct`, MEASURE(`invoice_count`) AS `invoice_count`, MEASURE(`active_customers`) AS `active_customers`, MEASURE(`average_invoice_value`) AS `average_invoice_value`, MEASURE(`returns_rate_pct`) AS `returns_rate_pct`
    FROM s3demo_dev.gold.sales_metrics
    WHERE (is_month_to_date OR is_same_days_last_year) AND (:province = 'All' OR province = :province) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group) AND (:channel = 'All' OR channel = :channel)
    GROUP BY ALL
  ) AS q
) AS previous
) AS kpis
ORDER BY row_order

datasets.name: 2655b9dc
queryLines:
WITH last_full AS (
  SELECT MAX(month_start_date) AS m FROM s3demo_dev.gold.dim_date WHERE is_last_complete_month
),
actual AS (
  SELECT d.month_start_date AS month, SUM(f.net_revenue_amount) AS amount
  FROM s3demo_dev.gold.fact_sales f
  JOIN s3demo_dev.gold.dim_date d ON f.invoice_date = d.date
  CROSS JOIN last_full
  WHERE d.month_start_date BETWEEN add_months(last_full.m, -12) AND last_full.m
  GROUP BY d.month_start_date
)
SELECT month, 'Actual' AS series, ROUND(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 1) AS lkr_m FROM actual
UNION ALL
SELECT month_start_date, s.series, ROUND(s.amount / 1e6, 1)
FROM s3demo_dev.gold.forecast
LATERAL VIEW stack(3, 'Forecast', CAST(forecast_net_revenue AS DOUBLE),
                      'Forecast low', CAST(low_net_revenue AS DOUBLE),
                      'Forecast high', CAST(high_net_revenue AS DOUBLE)) s AS series, amount

datasets.name: ce477ee2
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (SELECT max_by(run_id, generated_ts) AS run_id FROM s3demo_dev.gold.insights)
SELECT CASE i.severity WHEN 1 THEN 'Act now' WHEN 2 THEN 'Notable' ELSE 'Context' END AS priority,
       CASE i.kind WHEN 'revenue_drop' THEN 'Alert' WHEN 'stock_out' THEN 'Alert'
                   WHEN 'anomaly' THEN 'Unusual day' WHEN 'headline' THEN 'Headline'
                   WHEN 'mover' THEN 'What moved' WHEN 'forecast' THEN 'Forecast' END AS type,
       i.text AS finding,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.severity,
           CASE i.kind WHEN 'revenue_drop' THEN 1 WHEN 'stock_out' THEN 2 WHEN 'anomaly' THEN 3
                       WHEN 'headline' THEN 4 WHEN 'forecast' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END,
           abs(i.change) DESC) AS row_order
FROM s3demo_dev.gold.insights i
JOIN latest ON i.run_id = latest.run_id
WHERE i.kind IN ('revenue_drop', 'stock_out', 'anomaly')
   OR (i.kind = 'forecast' AND i.dimension = 'month')
   OR (i.kind = 'headline' AND i.metric = 'net_revenue'
       AND i.comparison IN ('mtd_vs_last_year', 'month_vs_last_year'))
   OR (i.kind = 'mover' AND i.severity <= 2 AND i.comparison = 'month_vs_last_year'
       AND i.dimension IN ('province', 'product_group'))
ORDER BY row_order
LIMIT 8

datasets.name: 3c6fb53f
queryLines:
WITH rec AS (
  SELECT * FROM s3demo_dev.ops.reconciliation
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_ts) FROM s3demo_dev.ops.reconciliation)
),
latest AS (SELECT MAX(invoice_date) AS d FROM s3demo_dev.gold.fact_sales)
SELECT concat('Data up to ', date_format(MAX(latest.d), 'd MMM yyyy'), '  |  ',
              CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rec.status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STRING), ' of ', CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING),
              ' daily checks against the SAP control totals passed') AS status
FROM rec CROSS JOIN latest

datasets.name: 2d307f6d
queryLines:
SELECT
  product,
  product_group,
  ROUND(CAST(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 2) AS lkr_m,
  ROUND((MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) / NULLIF(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_fiscal_year_to_date), 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS change_pct,
  CAST(MAX(units) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) AS DOUBLE) AS units,
  ROUND(MAX(gross_margin_pct) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date), 1) AS margin_pct
FROM (
  SELECT `product`, `product_group`, `is_fiscal_year_to_date`, MEASURE(`net_revenue`) AS `net_revenue`, MEASURE(`units`) AS `units`, MEASURE(`gross_margin_pct`) AS `gross_margin_pct`
  FROM s3demo_dev.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE (is_fiscal_year_to_date OR is_same_period_last_fiscal_year) AND (:province = 'All' OR province = :province) AND (:product_group = 'All' OR product_group = :product_group) AND (:channel = 'All' OR channel = :channel)
  GROUP BY ALL
) AS q
GROUP BY product, product_group
ORDER BY lkr_m DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

  province,
  ROUND(CAST(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 2) AS lkr_m,
  ROUND((MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE is_fiscal_year_to_date) / NULLIF(MAX(net_revenue) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_fiscal_year_to_date), 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS change_pct,

  GROUP BY ALL
) AS q
GROUP BY customer_name, customer_group, province
ORDER BY lkr_m DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 15
